findings.existing: 可数名词；a clump of + 复数植物或物质。
findings.issue: 『复数植物或物质』易误导：clump of grass可接不可数物质名词，clump of trees可接复数可数名词。
findings.proposed: 可数名词；a clump of后既可接复数可数名词（trees），也可接不可数物质名词（grass、soil）。

findings.existing: Her grandfather kept the telegram announcing his first job.
findings.issue: announcing his first job略显省略，可能指其首次任职而非获录用通知，阅读精确度可提高。
findings.proposed: Her grandfather kept the telegram telling him that he had been offered his first job.
findings.proposed_zh: 她的祖父一直保存着那封通知他获得第一份工作的电报。

notes: Editorial suggestions are not independently assessed. No teaching source overwritten; prior four findings remain open.
